note: TWICE's own vlogs and behind-the-scenes, from their official channels. One entry per episode. The page groups by series, not by year: a series is one tab and one section, and a series with "seasons" (TW-LOG) keeps every season inside that section, each under its own sub-heading, set on the entry by "season". A season can also carry a "summary" and "mustWatch", shown on its sub-heading, and "years" to override the span its dates give (a late upload shouldn't stretch it). TIME TO TWICE and TWICE TV (with its member TVs) are separate sections, not here.
